definition: A single task or reminder that can move through a todo status until it is done or removed.

fields.description: Stable identifier for the todo item.
fields.name: id

fields.description: Optional longer note explaining context or acceptance details.
fields.name: description

fields.description: Current lifecycle state of the item, represented by one TodoStatus value.
fields.name: status

fields.description: Optional date when the task should be completed.
fields.name: due_date

name: TodoItem
description: Defines the TodoItem business entity and explains how it is used in the modeled domain.
